statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is in the watch band while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Current evidence supports a WATCH classification: the retail-sales surprise raises event-path sensitivity, but live NQ mean-reversion failure is not independently verified.
headline: Retail-sales surprise raises pre-open event risk; Tail moves to WATCH ahead of the FOMC sequence
body: August retail sales rose 1.2%, above the Reuters consensus of 0.8%, while core control-group sales also surprised strongly. Fresh Finviz context shows broad megacap and semiconductor gains, oil has eased, and VIX remains below 17. Direct live NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so extreme Stress does not translate into a block-level Tail score. The main conditional risk window is the cash open through the FOMC decision and press conference.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 published hourly slots, Tail ranged from 17% to 23%. WATCH was concentrated during the prior U.S. session, while the overnight and European hours were mostly EA_ON; Stress stayed extreme throughout.
outlookSummary: The highest conditional risk remains the U.S. cash-open/FOMC sequence. Retail sales have already strengthened the rates-sensitive backdrop, but Tail escalation above WATCH still requires observed persistent NQ extension, weak retracements, or a credible delayed cross-asset second leg. The base case is gradual normalization after the Fed if price discovery becomes two-way.

forecast.analysis: Retail sales have already surprised to the upside, while fresh supplementary breadth is pro-tech and VIX remains subdued. Direct live NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so Tail is WATCH rather than an elevated block.
